To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we present the first two-step retrieval scheme to derive aerosol-corrected tropospheric NO_2 columns from MAX DOAS measurements, and that we demonstrate the applicability and the accuracy of the scheme by comparing the derived tropospheric NO-2 columns with OMI-sensor tropospheric NO_-2 columns and with AERONet aerosol optical depth measurements.

(1) the two-step retrieval scheme presented here is able to retrieve aerosol optical thickness and tropospheric NOx columns with an accuracy of 10% and better, from ground-based MAX-DOAS measurements, and (2) this retrieval scheme is able to retrieve tropospheric NOX columns from MAX- DOAS observations that agree with satellite observations within the uncertainty range of 10% for the ground-based observations.
the combination of relative intensity observations with MAX-DOAS is a powerful tool to retrieve aerosol corrected troposheric NO2 columns.
